termsGeneralBody:
These terms and conditions apply to all services provided by Fat7i and to the use of the Fat7i app, website and associated services.

By creating an account, booking a ride or making use of Fat7i's services, the user declares that they agree to these terms and conditions.

Fat7i offers taxi transport, VIP transport and passenger transport within the Netherlands and, where available, to destinations outside the Netherlands within Europe.
termsDefinitionsBody:
In these terms and conditions, the following definitions apply:

Fat7i: The provider of taxi, VIP and passenger transport services via the Fat7i app.

Customer / Passenger: The person who creates an account, books a ride or makes use of the transport service.

Driver: The driver who carries out the ride on behalf of Fat7i.

Ride: The transport service booked by the customer from the specified pick-up address to the specified destination.

App: Fat7i's mobile application through which customers can request, pay for and manage rides.
termsAccountBody:
3.1 Age requirement
A user must be at least 18 years old to create an Fat7i account and make use of the services.

3.2 One account per phone number
Each user may create a maximum of one Fat7i account per phone number. It is not permitted to create multiple accounts using the same phone number or to make use of false personal data. Fat7i reserves the right to block or remove duplicate, suspicious or fraudulent accounts.

3.3 Correct information
The customer is responsible for providing correct and up-to-date information, including:
• full name;
• phone number;
• email address;
• other information necessary for carrying out the ride.
If information is incorrect, incomplete or suspicious, Fat7i has the right to request additional information.
termsPricingPaymentBody:
6.1 Fixed ride price
The price shown during the booking process in the Fat7i app and confirmed by the customer is the fixed price for the booked ride. The price includes all costs that are clearly shown during the booking and will not be increased without a valid reason or a change to the booking details by the customer.

6.2 Change of price
The price may only be adjusted when the customer makes changes within the permitted period of 5 minutes after booking, such as: a different pick-up address; a different destination; more or fewer passengers; extra luggage; other changes that affect the ride. The new price is automatically shown in the app before the change is confirmed. After this period, the original booking and price remain applicable.

6.3 Available payment methods
Fat7i accepts the following payment methods: Visa; Mastercard; Apple Pay; Google Pay; iDEAL; PayPal; Klarna (In3, Pay Later). A ride is only definitively confirmed once payment in full has been successfully processed. Fat7i does not accept cash payments for rides booked via the app.

6.4 Invoices and proof of payment
After a successful payment and/or completed ride, the customer has access to the available documents in the Fat7i app. The customer can obtain proof of payment (receipt) and an official invoice. The customer can share these documents with third parties via the app.
termsCancellationRefundsBody:
7.1 Cancellation within 5 minutes
The customer may cancel the ride within 5 minutes of booking. In the event of cancellation within this period, an administrative cancellation fee of €6.50 will be applied and the remaining amount will be refunded.

7.2 Cancellation after 5 minutes
After the first 5 minutes have elapsed, the customer may cancel the ride at any time. In the event of such a cancellation, the customer will receive a maximum of 45% of the amount paid back. The remaining costs are considered compensation for the reserved capacity, preparation and planning of the ride.

7.3 Refunds
When the customer is entitled to a refund, the amount will be refunded via the same payment method used by the customer to make the payment. The maximum processing period for refunds is 2 working days, depending on processing by the relevant payment provider.

7.4 Cancellation by Fat7i
When Fat7i cancels a ride due to circumstances falling within Fat7i's responsibility, the customer will receive the amount paid back. In the event of a cancellation by Fat7i, an administrative fee of €6.50 will be deducted from the amount to be refunded. The remaining amount will be refunded via the same payment method used by the customer to pay for the ride. In addition, the customer will receive a 20% discount code for a future ride with Fat7i. This discount code is valid for 1 month after receipt and serves as compensation and an apology from Fat7i because the planned ride could not be carried out as usual.

7.5 No cash refunds
Refunds are processed exclusively digitally via the original payment method.
termsWaitingTimesBody:
8.1 Free waiting time for normal rides
At normal pick-up addresses, the customer receives a free waiting time of 10 minutes from the agreed pick-up time. After this period, the driver may decide to continue waiting, in which case waiting charges will apply, or to end the ride if the customer is not present (no-show). If the driver continues to wait, a waiting charge of €0.22 per minute will be charged.

8.2 Free waiting time for airport rides
For airport rides, a free waiting time of 45 minutes applies from the scheduled arrival time of the flight or the agreed pick-up time. After this period, the driver may decide to continue waiting with the waiting charge applied, or to end the ride if the customer is not available. The waiting charge is €0.22 per minute.

8.3 Driver arrives early
When the driver is present 15 minutes or more before the agreed pick-up time, the free waiting time does not start earlier. The free waiting time always starts from the originally agreed pick-up time of the ride.

8.4 Evidence in the event of cancellation due to no-show
When a ride is ended due to the customer's failure to appear, Fat7i may make use of evidence such as: the driver's arrival time; location data; WhatsApp conversations; phone records; screenshots of communication.
termsExecutionBody:
9.1 Availability of drivers
Fat7i strives to carry out every ride with an available Fat7i driver. When no Fat7i driver is temporarily available, Fat7i may offer the customer the option to wait up to 40 minutes until an available driver can be found. If the customer does not wish to wait, the customer may cancel the ride. In that case, €6.50 in cancellation costs will be charged and the remaining amount will be refunded in full.

9.2 External transport partners
In exceptional situations, Fat7i may make use of external transport partners to enable the provision of services. These partners only receive the information necessary to carry out the ride. Responsibility for the provision of services remains with Fat7i.
termsDelaysCompensationBody:
10.1 Delay caused by Fat7i
When Fat7i causes a delay of more than 30 minutes relative to the agreed time and the customer provides clear supporting evidence for this, such as communication with Fat7i, screenshots of phone conversations, evidence of an unexpected vehicle breakdown or other relevant documents, the customer may receive compensation.

When the ride is nevertheless carried out, the customer receives compensation of 20% of the ride value.

When the customer decides to cancel the ride due to this delay, the customer will receive the full amount paid back, less €6.50 in administrative costs.
termsForceMajeureBody:
Fat7i is not liable for delays or the inability to carry out a ride when this is caused by circumstances beyond Fat7i's control, including: severe storms; snow; extreme fog; flooding; major traffic accidents; road closures; strikes; government decisions; major problems with internet or payment systems; safety incidents.

When Fat7i judges that a ride cannot be carried out safely or responsibly, the ride may be cancelled. In this case, the customer will receive the amount paid back, €6.50 in administrative costs will be deducted, and the customer will receive a 20% discount code for a future ride. The discount code is valid for 1 month and is offered as compensation and an apology from Fat7i.
termsPassengerResponsibilitiesBody:
12.1 Correct use of the service
The passenger is required to use Fat7i's services in a normal, safe and respectful manner. The passenger must follow the driver's instructions regarding safety and use of the vehicle.

12.2 Safety and seatbelt
Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory under Dutch law. If a passenger refuses to wear the seatbelt after the driver has asked them to do so, the driver has the right not to start the ride or to end the ride. In such cases, no refund will be given.

12.3 Conduct during the ride
It is not permitted to: verbally or physically harass the driver; threaten the driver; display aggressive behaviour; endanger the safety of others. In the event of serious unacceptable behaviour, the driver may end the ride immediately. In that case, the ride price will not be refunded.
termsSmokingAlcoholTitle: 13. Smoking, alcohol and use of the vehicle
termsSmokingAlcoholBody:
13.1 Smoking and vaping
Smoking in the vehicle is prohibited. This applies to: cigarettes; cigars; shisha; electronic cigarettes (vapes).

13.2 Alcohol consumption
Drinking alcohol in the vehicle or disruptive behaviour caused by alcohol consumption is not permitted. The driver may refuse or end the ride when this affects safety or comfort.
termsVehicleUseTitle: 14. Use of the vehicle by passengers
termsVehicleUseBody: Passengers must use the vehicle with care. It is not permitted to: open doors forcefully or carelessly; place feet on the seats; damage the interior, screens or parts of the vehicle; eat or drink without the driver's permission. Damage caused by the passenger will be assessed in accordance with article 15.
termsDamageCleaningBody:
15.1 Compensation for damage
When a passenger causes damage to the vehicle, Fat7i may charge compensation of up to a maximum of €170. The assessment is based on: photos; the driver's report; cleaning invoices; repair invoices where necessary.

15.2 Cleaning costs
In the event of damage such as vomiting, spilled liquids or serious soiling, the actual cleaning costs will be charged up to a maximum of €170.

15.3 Damage or destruction
In the event of breakage, damage or destruction, the actual repair costs will be charged up to a maximum of €170. Fat7i retains the invoices and may recover outstanding amounts through a debt collection procedure. In the event of intentional damage or vandalism, Fat7i reserves the right to recover the full actual damage.
termsLuggageChildrenPetsBody:
16.1 Luggage
The passenger is responsible for correctly stating the number of pieces of luggage during the booking. Additional luggage that was not specified during the booking may be refused when safety or space requires it.

16.2 Children
The customer is themselves responsible for bringing any necessary child car seats. Fat7i does not provide child car seats.

16.3 Pets
Pets are only permitted when stated during the booking. The driver has the right to accept or refuse a pet based on: the type of animal; its size; safety; use of a suitable carrier. When the driver refuses the pet, a cancellation fee of €6.50 will apply. Assistance dogs are always permitted.
termsLostPropertyBody:
When a passenger leaves property behind in the vehicle, the passenger must contact the driver. If the customer wishes to have the property delivered to their home, the customer must book an official ride via Fat7i for this purpose. The pick-up point for this ride is Maassluis. The destination is chosen by the customer.

Alternatively, found property can be handed in free of charge at the police station in Maassluis. The customer can collect it there in person.
termsComplaintsBody:
Customers can submit complaints via: email; the contact form in the app. A complaint must contain at least: the ride number; the date of the ride; a description of the problem; any photos or supporting evidence.

Fat7i strives to respond to complaints within 14 working days. If a complaint is not resolved, the customer has the right to make use of competent authorities in the Netherlands.
termsAccountTerminationBody:
Fat7i has the right to temporarily block or permanently remove accounts when a user: uses false information; attempts to commit fraud; commits payment fraud; repeatedly cancels rides in a manner that harms the provision of services; threatens or mistreats the driver; repeatedly violates these terms and conditions; fails to pay outstanding damages or costs.

A blocked user may not create a new account to circumvent the block.
termsIntellectualPropertyBody: All rights relating to the Fat7i name, the logo, the application, the design and the content are owned by Fat7i. Copying, distributing or using these without permission is not permitted and may result in legal action under Dutch law.
termsChangesTitle: 21. Changes to the terms and conditions
termsChangesBody: Fat7i reserves the right to change these terms and conditions in the future. Users will be informed of significant changes via the app and the website.
termsApplicableLawBody:
Dutch law applies exclusively to all agreements with Fat7i.

privacyPolicyIntro:
Fat7i attaches great importance to the privacy and protection of the personal data of customers, drivers and users of our services.

In this privacy policy, we explain which personal data we collect, why we use this data, how we protect it, and which rights users have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR/AVG).

By using the Fat7i app, website and services, the user agrees to the processing of personal data as described in this privacy policy.
privacyPolicyAboutUsBody:
Fat7i is a Dutch transport company specialising in taxi, VIP and passenger transport.

We offer various transport services, including: business transport; VIP transport; care transport; airport transport within the Netherlands and neighbouring countries; city rides and tours.

Our mission is to offer reliable, comfortable and professional transport with clear pricing and simple digital solutions.
privacyPolicyDataCollectedBody:
Fat7i may collect the following personal data:

3.1 Account information
When a user creates an account, we may collect: name; phone number; email address; account details.

3.2 Ride information
To carry out a ride, we collect: pick-up location; destination; route data; date and time of the ride; number of passengers; luggage details; additional customer requests.

3.3 Location data (GPS)
With the user's consent, Fat7i may use location data to carry out the ride, for safety and monitoring during the ride, and to improve our services. GPS data is only used for these purposes.

3.4 Payment information
Fat7i processes payments via external payment providers. We do not store full bank card details such as the full card number, expiry date or CVV code. We only store necessary information such as the name of the payment service provider, payment status, the amount of the ride and the transaction number.
privacyPolicyCameraBody:
4.1 Cameras in vehicles
Fat7i's vehicles may be equipped with front-facing cameras, rear-facing cameras and cameras inside the vehicle. The presence of cameras is clearly indicated with a sticker in the vehicle.

4.2 Purpose of camera footage
Camera footage is used exclusively for the safety of passengers and drivers, investigation in the event of accidents, and protection of the rights of the driver and Fat7i in the event of complaints or legal situations. Camera footage is not used for other purposes.

4.3 Access to camera footage
Camera footage is only viewed when necessary, for example in the event of an accident, a complaint, a dispute or a request from competent authorities.
privacyPolicyAudioBody:
5.1 Activation by the passenger
Fat7i offers passengers the option to start an audio recording during the ride via the function available for this purpose in the app. The recording only starts when the passenger presses the record button themselves.

5.2 Use of audio recordings
Audio recordings are intended as evidence in situations such as complaints, safety issues and disputes. No one has access to the recording, except when the passenger shares it themselves with Fat7i or when this is legally required.
privacyPolicyRetentionBody:
Fat7i does not retain personal data for longer than necessary, except when legal obligations require a longer retention period.

6.1 Ride and financial data
Data relating to rides, invoices and financial administration is retained for a maximum of 7 years due to Dutch fiscal and administrative obligations.

6.2 Audio recordings and complaints
Audio recordings and data relating to complaints are retained for a maximum of 4 months, unless longer retention is necessary for a legal dispute or required by law.
privacyPolicySharingBody:
Fat7i only shares personal data when this is necessary for the provision of services or when this is legally required.

Data may be shared with: payment providers such as Klarna, iDEAL and PayPal; hosting and technical service providers; transport partners when this is necessary to carry out the ride; competent authorities when required by law.

Fat7i does not sell personal data to third parties.
privacyPolicyMarketingBody: Fat7i may inform users about promotional discounts, seasonal offers and new services. This communication is sent exclusively via the Fat7i app. Users can manage their preferences using the available settings in the app.
privacyPolicyCookiesTitle: 9. Use of cookies and tracking technology
privacyPolicyCookiesBody:
Fat7i's website and digital services may make use of Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram Pixel and other similar marketing tools. These technologies are used to analyse website usage, improve marketing campaigns and show relevant advertisements.

Users are given the option to adjust their cookie preferences via the cookie settings.
privacyPolicyPushNotificationsBody: The Fat7i app may make use of push notifications via technical services such as Firebase or comparable systems. Push notifications may be used to confirm bookings, provide updates about rides and share important notices about the provision of services.
privacyPolicyRightsBody:
Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR/AVG), the user has certain rights with regard to their personal data.

11.1 Right of access
The user may request access to the personal data that Fat7i processes about them.

11.2 Right to rectification
The user may request that incorrect or incomplete data be corrected.

11.3 Right to erasure of data
The user may request that their account be deleted via the Fat7i app. When a user submits a deletion request, the account is first deactivated and then deleted in accordance with the statutory retention periods. Data that must be retained under Dutch law, such as financial and administrative data, may be stored for the statutory period.

11.4 Right to object
The user may object to certain forms of data processing when this is permitted under the GDPR.
privacyPolicySecurityBody:
Fat7i takes appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against loss, unauthorised access, misuse and unwanted disclosure.

Access to personal data is restricted to persons and systems that genuinely need this data to carry out the services.
privacyPolicyResponsibilityBody:
Fat7i uses personal data solely for purposes necessary for: carrying out rides; customer service; safety; payment and administration; improvement of our services.

Fat7i ensures that data is processed carefully in accordance with applicable Dutch and European privacy legislation.
privacyPolicyAccountDeletionBody:
The user can submit a request via the Fat7i app to have their account deleted. Upon receipt of the request, the account is deactivated and deleted as soon as statutory retention obligations allow.

Deleting an account does not automatically mean that all data is immediately erased, when Fat7i is legally required to retain certain data.
privacyPolicyChildrenBody: Fat7i does not knowingly collect personal data from persons under 18 years of age for the purpose of creating an account. Users must be at least 18 years old to independently create an account and make use of the services.
privacyPolicyChangesBody:
Fat7i reserves the right to change this privacy policy when this is necessary due to changes in our services, technical developments or changes in laws and regulations.

Users will be informed of significant changes via the Fat7i app and the website.
privacyPolicyContactBody:
For questions, requests or complaints about privacy and the processing of personal data, the user can contact Fat7i via:

Email: admin@fat7i.dev
WhatsApp: 0639550352

Fat7i will handle requests and questions within the statutory time limits.
privacyPolicyApplicableLawBody: Dutch law applies to this privacy policy. Fat7i processes personal data in accordance with applicable Dutch and European privacy legislation, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR/AVG).
